articleTitle: Diagnostics of Professional Competencies and Motivation of the Engineer in the Knowledge Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The corporate audit of human capital relies on the diagnosis of the competence of employees, which are the key resource of the company in the process of creating a unique value for customers. Diagnostics of professional competencies in an innovative economy includes both highly specialized knowledge and skills of the engineer, as well as communicative, managerial and market competencies. In this connection, today the diagnostics of the engineer's professional competencies, on the one hand, includes a comprehensive analysis of the results of the professional activities of the engineer, and on the other, serves to develop a complex system of evaluation criteria and compensation management' models based on multi-criteria assessment, allowing to link the results of the engineer's work and various remuneration, from labor remuneration to the social package, motivating the development of certain professional competences of the engineer as a key subject creating the market value of the company.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Discrete Human-Machine Interaction for Providing Reliability and Cybersecurity of Critical Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The article considers the issues of preventing damage to complex critical systems, caused by cybersecurity unreliability and violations. The method of searching for ergonomic reserves is used. Within the framework of the human-system approach to the tasks of ensuring the reliability and cybersecurity of critical systems, the issues of human-machine interaction simulation by functional networks are considered. The activity of the human operator is proposed to be described in the terms of the functional-structural theory of the scientific school of professors A.I. Gubinsky and V.G. Evgrafov. The information technology was developed that ensures the implementation of procedures for describing, evaluating and variant simulation of human-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Information-logical Modeling of Information Collection and Processing at the Evaluation of the Functional Reliability of the Aviation Ergate Control System Operator
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The structure of the information-logical model is presented and the characteristics of the means and methods of data collection and processing are given when assessing the functional reliability of the operator of aviation ergatic control systems under the impact of aircraft noise.

Author Keywords: reliability of professional activity of aviation specialists
acoustic situation at workplaces of aviation specialists

articleTitle: Problems of Sustainable Development of Socio-Economic Systems in the Implementation of Innovations
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The problems of maintaining the stability of socioeconomic systems in the implementation of innovations are considered. In analyzing this problem, it is proposed to take into account the laws of the theory of systems.

Author Keywords: laws of the theory of systems

articleTitle: Development of Engineering Personnel in the Era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The process of transformation of the competence approach under the conditions of the 4th Industrial Revolution is being investigated. The trends in the development of a new era of the industrial revolution are explored, new prospects for the development of world and domestic production and technologies are revealed. The model of development of engineering personnel on the example of South Korean companies is considered. The shortcomings and advantages of modern approaches to the formation and management of the professional competences of engineering personnel are discussed. Recommendations are proposed for improving the competence model in the context of the globalization of industrial economies.

articleTitle: Methods and Technologies of Computer Training Complexes Design for Personnel in Metallurgical Production Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In article methods and technologies of design of computer training complexes including creation of models of representation of unformalized knowledge, multiple adaptive information and mathematical models, models of the trainee, the system of formation of scenarios and protocols of training, the strategy of resource-saving control of technological processes and also models of monitoring of knowledge are offered. Use of computer simulators allows to raise the security level of metallurgical productions, to raise a resource of trouble-free operation of thermal aggregates, to improve quality of production of steel-smelting productions on the chemical composition and an inner pattern, to improve ecological characteristics of the production environment due to increase in the professional grade of an administrative production staff.

articleTitle: The Substantiation of the Project Management System for Company by Means of the Functional Completeness Criteria in Innovative Company
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The article discusses the approach to the conduct and justification of the selection of the project management system and the utilization of labor resources using the method of comparative quantitative assessment of the quality of systems based on the functional completeness criterion to ensure the definition of a suitable system for supporting the activities of the IT company. The article determines the tools for solving the problem of effective project management and ensuring control over the workload of employees, which makes it possible to assess the possibility of personnel working in new projects.

articleTitle: A Social Engineer in Terms of Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: Problem: Today, many methods of influencing on personnel in the communication process are available to social engineers and information security specialists, but in practice it is difficult to say which method and why it is appropriate to use one. Criteria and indicators of effective communication are not formalized. Purpose: to formalize the concept of effective communication, to offer a tool for combining existing methods and means of communication, to formalize the purpose of communication. Methods: Use of the terminal model of a control system for a non-stochastic communication object. Results. Two examples demonstrating the possibility of using the terminal model of the communication control system, which allows you to connect tools and methods of communication, justify the requirements for the structure and feedback of communication, select the necessary communication algorithms depending on the observed response of the communication object. Practical significance: the results of the research can be used in planning and conducting effective communication in the process of information protection, in business, in private relationships and in other areas of human activity.

articleTitle: Measurement of Static and Dynamic Bio- Parameters of a Person in Remote Systems for Current Psycho- Emotional and Functional State Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper substantiates the need to measure both static and dynamic bio-parameters of a person in remote systems for the current psycho-emotional and functional state of a dangerous object managing operators monitoring. Classification of registered bio-parameters is given. It is shown that it is expedient to use the static bio-parameters primarily for solving the problems of searching for the person's face in the frame and identifying his personality. Dynamic bio-parameters are the most informative for determining the current level of stress, fatigue, as well as assessing the available resources of the person. For registration of static and dynamic bio-parameters of a person it is proposed to use passive non-contact optical and acoustic technologies. The complex registration and processing of static and dynamic bio-parameters makes it possible to implement reliable monitoring of the current state of a hazardous object control operators.

articleTitle: The Development of a Remote Fetal Activity Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The various methods of fetal activity registration are considered. The main advantages of passive methods in remote monitoring systems of fetal condition are described. A system based on the use of MEMS accelerometers is proposed, which will allow remote monitoring of fetal activity.

articleTitle: Problems of Developing Decision Rules in Decision Support Systems for Assessing Innovative Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The main problems of developing and implementing decision rules in intelligent decision support systems for assessing the efficiency and feasibility of innovative technical solutions are considered in the paper. Errors in the formation of decisive product rules are usually critical and can significantly reduce the efficiency of the algorithms of intelligent systems. As ways to combat this problem, the paper presents the basic principles of the formation of the decisive product rules, as well as the principles for determining the boundary values of the efficiency and the feasibility of innovative technical solutions for identifying areas of decision-making. An analysis of developing decision rules in decision support systems for assessing innovative solutions in the field of energy efficiency is performed as a calculation example.

articleTitle: The Experience of the Master's Educational Program Implementation “User Interface Ergodesign”
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The validity and practical significance of the interdisciplinary applied master program “User Interface Ergodesign” is justified. Detailed description of its content and key features of its implementation at the Southern Federal University is given. A short review of the achieved results is considered, and prospective directions of the applied scientific and practical research development in the field of user interface ergodesign are reviewed.

articleTitle: Methods and Algorithms for Atrial Fibrillation Episodes Detection in Condition of Alternant Premature Contractions and Atrial Flutter
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: ECG signal processing and analysis for the on-line atrial fibrillation detection by remote monitoring systems of patient's heart rhythm under physical activity condition. In order to improve atrial fibrillation episodes diagnostics reliability methods and algorithms of alternant premature contractions and atrial flutter detection, reduction of electromyographic noise and artifacts of locomotor activity are developed. Algorithm of atrial fibrillation detection based on complexification of diagnostically significant parameters is suggested.

Author Keywords: methods of signal processing and analysis
specificity and sensitivity of the method

articleTitle: Innovative Forms of Financial Institution Management: Cloud Automated Banking Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: At the present stage, another form of cloud computing is being developed in the financial sphere. It is a cloud automated banking system that forms a new paradigm in the management of a financial institution. The paper examines the perspectives for implementing cloud automated banking systems in Russia and in the world. In this regard, the paper analyzes the world and Russian markets of cloud computing at the current stage of development. The scope of cloud technologies application in the financial sphere is investigated; an emphasis is placed on the use of cloud automated banking systems. In addition, a comparative analysis of cloud banking systems application in the world and Russia is conducted. The architecture of a cloud banking system, which allows to provide new forms of financial institution management, is analyzed. In the final, the research in the field of economic efficiency of the cloud banking system in comparison with the traditional automated banking system is carried-out.

articleTitle: System Analysis of Innovative Technologies of the Industrial Revolutions
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The analysis of development industrial revolutions technological innovations is carried out. It is shown that at the present time, innovations and their modifications form a rather extensive disordered space, which is continuously expanding. It is proposed to apply methods of system analysis in the analysis analyzing this space and choosing innovations for specific enterprises and organizations.

articleTitle: Industrial Injuries in the Socio-Economic Aspect
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The industrial injuries phenomenon is considered in its socio-economic aspect in the article. The results of Russian enterprises official statistics on the occupational health and safety conditions analysis in dynamics over a ten-year period from 2007 to 2016 are given. To improve working conditions, a model for assessing the industrial injuries damage is proposed as a motivational tool for enterprises owners.

articleTitle: Model of Purpose Aggressive Actions on the Information-Computing System
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: Information-computing systems are the brain of an increasing number of enterprises and are subject for the malefactor actions. To adequately resist the actions of a malefactor, its adequate model is necessary. The article offers a non-stochastic model allowing to assess the possibilities of a malefactor on the impact on the information-computing system. The applicability area are shown.

articleTitle: Influence of Heart Rate Variability on Algorithm of Blood Pressure Estimation by Pulse Wave Propagation Time
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper presents modification of algorithm for the estimation of arterial blood pressure by the pulse wave propagation time. The work of the previously developed algorithm for evaluation of human blood pressure by pulse wave propagation time and the problem of its further optimization, based on the analysis of data for fifteen series of measurements of synchronously recorded electrocardiogram and pulse wave signals in twenty healthy subjects, was considered. The hypothesis about influence of heart rate variability on error of algorithm for blood pressure estimation by pulse wave propagation time was verified. As the result of this investigation, in order to increase the efficiency of the algorithm for arterial pressure indirect estimation, while calculating correction factors, it is necessary to use not only the current values of the heart rate, but also the average values. This requires preliminary registration of electrocardiogram signal for rather long time and using complex algorithms for signal processing.

articleTitle: Resort and Spa Sector Budget-Funding Economic Units Employees Household and Social Ergonomics Modern Aspects
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In this article are disclosed resort and spa sector budget-funding economic units employees' household and social ergonomics improvement basic points. There are suggested its refinement possible ways with domical cottages construction technology actualization as ecologic, ergonomic, aesthetic, economically accessible housing for resort and spa sector employees in Crimea, barrel bathhouses technology applying for their physical and psychological state refinement, 3D printing food fusion menu in-house relax center creating. During these recommendations realization will be achieved positive complex economical, social, ecologic, infrastructural economy effect.

articleTitle: Engineering and Psychological Problems of Multidimensional Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The problem of effectiveness of two-dimensional and three-dimensional presentations of the visual information and their conjunction with physical reality is considered. Several problems are analyzed which occur while embedding more dimensions into user interfaces, their probable fields of application are being studied. The question of implementation of multidimensional spatial solutions in multimodal interfaces is stated.

articleTitle: Training of Ergonomists (Preparation and Retraining)
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The analysis of a spectrum of the problems arising at preparation of ergonomists, and prospects of development of training on the given direction in Russia is carried out. Successes in training, as well as peculiarities of the demand for such specialists in various fields, were noted. The specifics of training are analyzed. The complex of basic disciplines realized in the process of bachelor's and master's training is given. The problems of retraining specialists from various fields of activity in the field of ergonomics (total volume from 64 to 72 hours) are considered: ergonomic design support, ergonomic expertise; assessment and design of workplaces and environmental conditions; evaluation and design of the interface; the fundamentals of professional selection.

articleTitle: Methods and Technologies of Computer Simulators Synthesis for Control by Electrotechnological Installations in SCADA HMI
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The synthesis method and technologies of computer simulators in the medium SCADA-systems are offered. Simulators are used for personnel training and increase of the control efficiency by electrotechnological installations in manufactures of aluminum, calcium carbide and phosphorus. The functional structure of simulators, information and mathematical software, software realization examples are developed.

Author Keywords: the synthesis method and technologies of computer simulators in the medium SCADA-systems

articleTitle: Development of the Software Complex for Planning and Simulation of Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The present paper discusses the relation between patients' erectile dysfunction after a minimally invasive radical nerve-sparing prostatectomy with an increased risk of a positive surgical margin during surgery. Identification of various complications in the postoperative period, along with erectile dysfunction, indicates the need to improve surgical techniques and develop methods for preoperative planning for minimally invasive radical nerve-sparing prostatectomy. The paper proposes a structure of a software complex for planning and simulating robot-assisted radical nerve-sparing prostatectomy. The software complex includes algorithmic tools for generating three-dimensional models of patients based on computer and magnetic resonance imaging with the use of adaptive deformable models with statistical restriction of deformation. This also includes means of simulating minimally invasive surgical influences by using the software for physical modeling.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Fetal Heart Rate Variability by Means of the Abdominal Electrocardiogram Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The question of the vital indicators continuous monitoring cannot be solved separately from the question of creating a system suitable for use in everyday life, without significant discomfort for the patient. Miniaturization, advanced electrode materials and transition to the wireless technology may help to solve several problems related to user convenience but will cause a whole range of new technical and methodological issues. Main approaches to the solution of the fetal electrocardiogram recording problems are discussed in the article. Solution that can be applied in the system of long-term monitoring in conditions of life activities is proposed.

articleTitle: Formation Features of Criterias for Assessing the Feasibility of Innovative Technical Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper presents a criteria set developed by the authors to solve the problem of effective evaluating the feasibility of innovative technical solutions and technologies based on artificial intelligence methods. The paper illustrates the main criteria and principles for their formation, as well as an analysis of the evaluated impact of each criterion on the accuracy of assessing the efficiency and feasibility of innovative technical solutions and technologies. An analysis of assessing the efficiency of innovative technical solutions and technologies in the field of energy efficiency based on the developed set of criteria is presented as a calculation example.

articleTitle: Acoustic Safety of Professional Activity of State Aviation Flight Crews
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: Based on the results of theoretical and experimental studies, it has been shown that it is necessary to develop and implement special means and methods for ensuring the acoustic safety of the professional activities of the flight staff of state aviation as an integral part of the system for ensuring the safe operation of air transport.

articleTitle: Analysis and Combination of Activity Algorithms Evaluation Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The article focuses on the issues of designing information human-machine systems and the importance of accounting for the human factor through analysis and ergonomic evaluation of the operator's activity algorithm. The article proposes an approach to improve the process of evaluation of stereo-typity and logical complexity of an algorithm and to ensure the reliability of this evaluation. This approach is based on the application of a generalized structural method and enhances the ergonomic evaluation of such activity algorithm indicators as stereo-typity and logical complexity.

articleTitle: Information Technology for Distribution of Functions between Operators as a Means of Improving the Reliability of Polyergatic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The article deals with polyerhetic automated systems and describe the problem of optimal fixing requests arriving at random times by operators of the system. We study the issues of efficiency and expediency of using information technology and describe models and information technology of function distribution that are built using the methods of the functional and structural theory of ergo-technical systems of Professor Anatoly Gubinsky. We chose the probability of error-free and timely execution of the request as the main indicator of quality, conducted the computer experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed models and tools, and described the methodology of the experiments to demonstrate that the use of the developed information technology provides a significant improvement in the quality of solutions related to the distribution of functions between operators in automated systems.

articleTitle: Hardware and Software Complex for the Synthesis of Lower Limb Prostheses Using Unified Components
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper discusses the development of a hardware-software complex for the synthesis of lower limb prostheses using unified components. The hardware complex consists of technical means for assessing anthropometric, physiological and biomechanical characteristics of the lower limbs left after amputations, which are used to model a prosthesis with specified characteristics based on the use of unified prosthesis components. The software package contains databases of knowledge on the basis of which the synthesis of individualized patient-specific prostheses is performed. The synthesis is carried out based on the results of the instrumental examination and database of characteristics of various unified components.

Author Keywords: synthesis of the lower limb prosthesis
physiological and biomechanical characteristics of the prosthetic

articleTitle: The Problem of Pulse Wave Feature Points Detection in Algorithms for Indirect Blood Pressure Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the common problems in identifying the key points of pulse wave. For the processing of synchronous recorded pulse wave and electrocardiogram signals a software module has been developed in MATLAB program. This module provides displaying of the signals, key points detection, pulse wave transit time calculation and evaluation of the variability of this parameter. For estimation of the characteristic form of the pulse wave an averaged model of several neighbor cardiac cycles depending on reference point is developed. The model allows visually evaluating the shape of the pulse wave and determining the average parameters values for the selected segment. To assess the variability of pulse wave shape overlapping could be implemented.

articleTitle: Methodology of Estimation of Experts 'Qualification Based on Professiogram with the Use of the Fuzzy Logic and the Psycholinguistic Analysis of Speech
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: methods used in the compilation of professiogram are considered; analysis of traditional recruitment tools is given; use of the apparatus of fuzzy logic and psycholinguistic analysis of speech in the preparation of a professiogram and assessment of the expert's qualifications is proposed in the article.

articleTitle: Innovation Complexity - a New Paradigm for Cognitive Ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper presents new principles of multidimensional data image generation for monitoring the behavior of complex systems by means of cognitive machine graphics. These images create in the mind of the human operator cognitive spectacular images that reveal the topological features of multidimensional data structures. Such images have an aesthetic appeal and stimulate human intuition in relation to the subject interpretation of the properties of complex systems that gave rise to this data. In other words, when these images are perceived, the human operator is able to identify individual geometric properties of the observed image and associate them with the subject content of the processed multidimensional data. Fundamentally new algorithmic approaches of cognitive visualization based on the representation of a set of points in multidimensional Euclidean space as a topological map in the form of simplices and polyhedra are proposed. Such a partition of Euclidean space into simplices allows revealing topological invariants hidden for the operator in multidimensional data, which in a certain sense determine the key characteristics of the behavior of complex systems. It is very important to combine the proposed cognitive technology with the modern capabilities of intelligent software interfaces and multidimensional statistical data analysis programs.

Author Keywords: algorithms of cognitive visualization of the situation

articleTitle: Development of Program-Algorithmic Support on the Basis of GIS in Designing and Operation of the Railway Track
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The necessity of development of program-algorithmic support on the basis of geographic information systems for monitoring the railway track and surrounding areas is substantiated. Describes the implementation of a stationary, on-Board and Central information-measuring systems for the formation of information warning of the emergency and pre-emergency condition of the track and technical structures. The article describes the formation of a database of defects in the linear section of the railway.

articleTitle: Method of Increasing the Security of Information Based on the Analysis of Keyboard Typing
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The aim of this work is to develop a method for increasing the security of information based on the analysis of keyboard hand typing. The paper considers a function that takes into account the minimum and maximum limits of biometric characteristics and the dependence of the stability of keyboard typing on its stability. As a result, a deviation factor is introduced to determine how much the biometric characteristic of the user after normalization will vary from the average value, which in its turn allows to determine the percentage of authenticity of the computer information system user. As a result, the probability of occurrence of errors of the first and second kind is reduced in comparison with the existing methods of authentication.

articleTitle: Method of Creating Biometric Keys Based on the Analysis of Keyboard Hand Typing
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In this work are considered the issues of increasing the security of information on the basis of the analysis of the keyboard hand typing, thanks to the creation of biometric access keys. Psychophysiological changes in the user's state during the working day are taken into account in order to reduce the probability of FAR (False Acceptance Rate) and FRR (False Rejection Rate) errors. The method is based on reading the biometric characteristics of the user's keyboard hand typing in various states. As well as finding the necessary patterns of their changes during the working day, which is an additional unique information about each user, due to which the accuracy of identity and user authentication is increased, thereby increasing the information security in the enterprise as a whole.

articleTitle: Innovative Methods of Personnel Management Based on Total Quality Concept
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The article considers the issues of the optimization of the personnel management from the perspective of the quality management system (QMS). The research analyses from the personnel management point the basic principles of Total quality concept, implementation of which allows to increase the effectiveness of the departments in charge of staff training and the effectiveness of the company in general. The article offers the recommendations to identify the resources needed to provide the staff quality, the technology to detect the non-production costs in the personnel' s professional activity, the technique to reveal the source of potential problems that allows to plan the list of actions to prevent the emergence of problems.

articleTitle: Techniques of Educating Specialists to Train Cosmonauts for the Space Flight Program Implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper considers peculiarities of cosmonauts' professional activities and their training for space flight program implementation. It is expected that improving the quality of training of astronauts can be obtained as a result of the improvement of concepts and methodologies of the formation of the professional level of cosmonaut training specialists (CTS). This article analyzes the features of learning CTS and their tasks in the course of its activities. It also presents basic techniques to form a professional-pedagogical image of CTS and shows the logical relationship between educational system and control over it as well as requirements for professional competence of CTS and management of their activities.

Author Keywords: education of specialists for cosmonauts' training

articleTitle: Visualization Technique for Representing Structure of the Cluster of Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In practice, there is often a need to evaluate the distribution of objects across clusters, taking into account their type, to identify possible anomalies in the structure of clusters. The report formulates the basic requirements for the model of graphical representation intended for solving this problem, several models of visualizing the structure of clusters were proposed, their main advantages and disadvantages were analyzed. A study was made on the effect of the choice of the visualization method on the subsequent decision-making by a person.

articleTitle: Ensuring of Professional Activities Reliability for Electric Power Operational and Exploitational Personnel
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The issues of ensuring the professional activity reliability of the operational and exploitational (OE) personnel of the electric power industry are considered. The analysis of the conditions of professional activity of personnel at the objects of electro-energy of various levels is given. An integrated approach to ensuring the professional activity reliability is proposed on the basis of current state continuous monitoring of OE personnel. The requirements for the monitoring tools used are formulated depending on the characteristics of the personnel professional activities. Remote non-contact technologies for recording current human bio-parameters are identified as the most promising. The results of the experimental approbation of the integrated approach are analyzed.

articleTitle: On Supporting of Decision-Making Process in the Area of Social Services
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This article analyzes a possibility and feasibility of assessing prospectivity of social services in terms of meeting needs of population and development of social sphere in relation with impact on reproduction of individual and aggregate human capital assets. Authors place special emphasis on taking into account the principle of social services priority in the framework of commercial and non-commercial motivation of economic entities which provide such services.

Author Keywords: decision-making process in assessing the prospects of social services

articleTitle: Improvement of Methods for Detection of Characteristic Points of Biomedical Signals Based on Continuous Wavelet Transformation in the Continuous Flow of Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The method of continuous wavelet transform for processing biomedical signals is considered in this paper. The algorithm of continuous wavelet transformation, based on the absence of boundary effects in the continuous data flow, is proposed. On the basis of the proposed wavelet transformation algorithm, the method for detection of complex QRS detection of ECG signal and the method for detection of normative points of pulse wave signal are presented.

articleTitle: Ergonomics in Early Phase Design in Industry – Proposals for Future Development Actions
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This article discusses how human factors and ergonomics (HFE), combined with work study methods, can contribute to industrial design and management processes. A brief overview of the state of the art of the utilization of HFE and work study methods in Finland is provided, and discussion is initiated regarding the possibilities for future utilization. Keywords-ergonomics; human factors; industrial engineering; method design; operational design; processes; product design; work study.

articleTitle: Training of Innovative Specialists for Strategic Management of Enterprises of High-Tech Industries
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The general principles of building strategic management systems and the modern management cycle are considered in the article. Particular attention is paid to the effectiveness of the staff system and its integration into the common system of strategic development of enterprises of high-tech industries.

articleTitle: The Model of Professional Competences' Development in South Korea
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The model of development of engineering personnel on the example of South Korean companies is considered. The shortcomings and advantages of modern approaches to the formation and management of the professional competences of engineering personnel are discussed. Recommendations are proposed for improving the competence model in the con-text of the globalization of industrial economies. The article examines the development trends of human resources in high-tech industries by the example of South Korea. The author reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the existing model, explores the international experience of managing competences and gives recommendations. The process of transformation of the competence approach in the conditions of dynamically developing external environment is investigated. Trends in the development of a new era of industrial revolution are explored, new prospects for the development of world and domestic production and technologies are emerging.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dynamics of Demand, Revenue and Ergonomic Aspects of Tourism
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The results of statistical and econometric modeling of tourist expenditures are used to assess and forecast the development of tourism in different countries or regions. The main difficulty of statistical observation in tourism and in tourism statistics as a whole lies in the impossibility of classifying tourism in any particular sector in the economic and statistical sense of the word. The tourism industry has interrelations with various sectors and types of economic activity, the description of which requires the use of various statistical forms. Demand for tourist services in certain periods of time can grow even exponentially, depending on the number of tourists, the quality of the environment, the market price of recreation and its duration of the holiday season.

articleTitle: Supporting the Process of Training Specialists in an Integrated Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In the conditions of growth of the digital economy there are changes in the educational process, caused by the introduction of electronic and distance learning technologies. The learning process takes place in an information-rich environment that requires flexible change management. The purpose of maintenance the process of training specialists in the university is to get more objective feedback for the management of the learning process and to organize the structure and content of training resources effectively for each student. It is necessary to take into account the individual differences, preferences, needs and goals of students, the dynamics of “growth” in the level of knowledge, classify students into groups based on personal characteristics of the cognitive sphere, find templates and apply measures for adapting and customizing the individual learning process. Technologies of intelligent (virtual) agents based on data mining methods allow to implement the approach of designing a personal educational environment controlled by data.

articleTitle: Generating Business Game “Occupational and Health Safety”
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper considers development and implementation of the generating game for training in occupational health and safety rules. It shows the major difference between generating game of this type and the ones which teach equipment operation. The actual difference is the fact that these games actualize awareness of a particular person about the dangerous factors in his work. The game consists of 155 cards presenting the events stipulated in the regulations by the Rules on labor safety in operation of electricity generating equipment.

articleTitle: May the Occurrence of Traffic Participants' Workload Be Programmed by the Engineers?
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper presents a hypothesis that the occurrence of a higher level of workload as well as a lower level of traffic participants' performance can be caused by the simultaneous factors from working and traffic environment, which can be programmed by the engineers during the design and / or run transport processes, because of their lack of knowledge as well as lack of experience in expert work. By using a compilation of the findings from the past own studies for several different branches of transport, the need has been pointed out to implement learning based on own research results in cooperation with the real transport sector as well as the need to include graduate and doctoral students in the concrete research applied in the real transport sector. Also, the need to measure a real span of values for many different factors from traffic and working environment has been noted, due to the setting of research drafts for performance measuring in the laboratory conditions. Finally, some typical non-ergonomic situations from traffic and working environment in Croatia have been analyzed, for which the engineers who run those traffic processes are responsible. The highlight is on the need to educate the stakeholders to create awareness of high-quality Human Factors and Ergonomics and its contributions to transport processes design in Croatia.

articleTitle: Method of Visualization of Terminological Dictionaries and Ontologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The organization of knowledge plays a key role in scientific research. The method of visualization of terminological dictionaries of linguistic support of the automated system of scientific researches is offered. This method allows to create a convenient web environment for the user's session, provides an opportunity to visually search, structure, classify terms of the knowledge domain and build ontologies using graphical diagrams. Algorithms for editing ontologies in the form of loaded graphs of classes, properties, semantic relations are implemented in the software package Ontomaster-Ontology, which allows you to improve the performance of network mode experts in subject areas that are not specialists in the field of ontology language of the international standard OWL-DL of semantic Web. The method is applied in the development of dynamic thesauri and ontologies of knowledge areas.

articleTitle: Isometric Method of Continuous Streaming Monitoring of Neuro-physiological States of a Person for the Professional Diagnostics and Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The report is dedicated to the new method of continuous streaming monitoring of neurophysiological states of a person. The method is based on the analysis of involuntary oscillatory movements of human limbs, the said movements being separated on the background of voluntary movements taking place when a person tries to form isometric force. Involuntary movements proceed in the form of a simple reflective act, and the states of a person could be assessed on the changes in their characteristics. The paper presents software and hardware means implementing the method, and contains the technique of their application for professional diagnostics and selection.

articleTitle: Generative Games for Ground and Simulator Training of Flight Crew
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The generative games in aviation are used to increase readiness for actions in an extreme situation due to accelerated building and further maintenance of the IMAGE of a PROFESSIONAL, including the image of professional flight activity, which leads to increase in reliability of the activity. An important element of the generative scenario in a crew / group is to add experience and put it into practice, i.e. to strengthen it. At the same time, different crews / groups creating the participants' experience resort to different scenarios, which can finally lead to absolutely unlike results including those that concern flight safety. In the course of a game situation, pilots can see the interaction process, on the one hand, and they are engaged into it, on the other hand. Everyone resorts to their own scenario and can see what their actions lead to in the end of the game. During the game, one could study how leadership skills are demonstrated and how situational understanding of any following action is formed by the group when a passenger in a game situation spontaneously assumes responsibility and says: “Landed ...”, i.e. the game generates a chain of the situations that requests decision-making. In general, one could speak of development of skills recommended by the International community in course of games. The basis is made by of participants' interaction in a game situation together with resorting to one's own scenario.

articleTitle: Reengineering of Corporate Management in the Innovative Context and Professional Competencies of a Reengineer
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The reengineering approach helps to create a system of efficient management for flexible companies within the changing world and innovative growth. The real value is created and captured by people who are able to detect the new customers' needs or to discover new paths for market evolution. In order to assess a product or service as new and attractive, to motivate or communicate, humans use nominalization on the basis of verbal evaluations, presented in the language. The process description based on the identification of values passes through structuring activities and algorithms towards the nominalization of functions and roles as positions and semantic entities, that make sense of activity. Functional operations reflect not only tasks that are verbally fixed, but also actions as a phase of uncertainty and multi-factor continuous choice, decision-making and outcome evaluation. Digital twins are a vivid example of a tool that provides a huge volume of data, but does not reduce uncertainty, that requires interpretation and reflection to produce a meaning. The concept of reengineering in the digital economy relies both on data collection and their intellectual analysis, and on the synthesis of conclusions based on linguistic nominalization.

articleTitle: Information and Technological Training of the Human Reserve in the Conditions of a Lean Enterprise Creation
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The issues of information and technological training of the personnel reserve in the conditions of creation of the social structure of a lean enterprise are considered. It is assumed that the principles of lean production extend to all processes of modern organization, including staffing, and can also be applied in enterprises of different industries, provided the appropriate management training. This sets new tasks for professional education, suggesting the necessary modification of educational programs and the development of new training modules adapted to the information environment, containing interdisciplinary knowledge and tools for solving practical problems.

articleTitle: Performance Expert Analysis of Personnel Working with Young People
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This article describes results of a study on correlation between normative performance, motivation and personal qualities of the personnel of a state budget institution engaged in prevention of asocial behavior among young people. The study showed that there is no link between the normative performance criteria, motivational structure and personal qualities of the personnel, therefore, the criteria cannot serve as a basis for assessing the effectiveness of work activity.

articleTitle: On the Problem of Meeting Organizational Stress and Physical Weariness under the Extrime Conditions of Professional Activity
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: In this empirical research we are looking for establishing the professional and personality features of operating personnel, the features that are related to the development of the worker's ability to keep in optimal balance his or her internal states while operating under hazardous conditions of professional activity-the balance which would exclude an overwhelming physical weariness and strongly pronounced organizational stress.

articleTitle: Monitoring of the Psychological Climate in the Team on the Basis of Acoustic Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The urgency of the psychological climate monitoring in the team is emphasized in order to minimize the probability of man-made accidents and catastrophes occurrence caused by the human factor. The use of acoustic technologies for the analysis of speech messages as a tool for assessing the level of nervous tension and stress is proposed. To visualize information about the psychological climate state in the team, it is suggested to use a graph that allows to display the level of all interpersonal relations. The possibility of applying the technology for analyzing the dynamics and forecast of the trends in the psychological climate change in the team is shown.

articleTitle: Innovative Forms of Interaction between Financial Institutions and Clients: Automated Banking Offices
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: The paper considers new innovative forms of cooperation between clients and financial institutions - fully automated banking offices. The classification of automated banking offices is given based on a number of characteristics: the occupied area, the type of performed operations. The architecture of such offices to provide the entire range of clients operations is analyzed. A study that reflects the implementation of automated banking offices in different countries is conducted. Besides leaders in this area identifies and the amount of investment determines. The estimation of economic efficiency of the automated banking office in comparison with the traditional office of financial institute is made. On the basis of the carried-out analysis the future development of such offices are defined.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic for Evaluating Electrician Maintenance Teams at Transmission Lines Work Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper aims to show an algorithm for measuring performance of a variety of psychosocial risks factors involving the evaluation of activities and work environment of Electrician Maintenance Teams at Electricity Transmission Lines. The proposed Evaluation Complex System utilizes fuzzy logic to process the evaluation by the application of linguistic terms as variables and executing many fuzzy logic operations to classify, aggregate and treat data sources. The research was applied, as a pilot experience, in a company that operates at the Brazilian electric sector, to some teams of electricians. The results are shown to be important to redesign the human resources strategies and investments, with the objective of reducing risks to the workers and providing them with a better work environment. As a consequence, the company achieves better revenue levels by reducing accidents and disruptor events that cause penalties according to the transmission lines concession contract responsibilities rules.

articleTitle: The Kitchen Assistants' Activities as a Regulating Factor: Case of a University Restaurant
publicationTitle: 2018 Third International Conference on Human Factors in Complex Technical Systems and Environments (ERGO)s and Environments (ERGO)
abstract: This paper aims to present the results of the Ergonomic Work Analysis realized with the staff that serves meals at three units of a new University Restaurant project in Rio de Janeiro (Brazil). The focus was on the activity of the transported ready-made meal distribution at the serving counter. The initial demands were to analyze the high rates of staff turnover and the complaints related to the kitchen assistants' physical fatigue and mental strain. The systematic analysis of the different ingredients portioning process was carried out in order to identify the causes of the physical and mental exhaustion reported. The method of self-confrontation interviews allowed to understand the strategies used by the kitchen assistants to reduce distinct sources of conflicts. The diagnostic and validation of the suggested recommendations were presented to the restaurant director. As a result, the initial project's concept of fixed portioning became more flexible.
